select count(*) from room_inventory where room_id = #{roomId} and stay_date >= #{start} and stay_date < #{end}

update room_order set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update room_order set pay_status = 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0 and pay_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0 and created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

update room_order set status = 2, pay_status = case when pay_status = 1 then 2 else pay_status end, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0 and pay_status in (0, 1) and is_deleted = 0 and checkin_time > #{now}

mapper.update: update meal_order set order_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and order_status = #{originalStatus} and is_deleted = 0
update meal_order set order_status = 3, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and order_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select o.id, coalesce(u.name, i.name) as name, coalesce(u.phone, i.phone) as phone, coalesce(u.id_card_number, i.id_card_number) as idCard, r.room_number, o.checkin_time as checkInTime, o.checkout_time as checkOutTime, o.status, o.comment, o.comment_star from room_order o left join user u on u.id = o.user_id left join individual i on i.id = o.individual_id left join room r on r.id = o.room_id where o.is_deleted = 0 order by o.id limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select n.night as date, sum(n.price) as revenue, count(*) as nightCount from room_order_night n join room_order o on o.id = n.room_order_id where n.night between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and o.pay_status = 1 and o.status != 2 and o.is_deleted = 0 group by n.night

select coalesce(sum(n.price), 0) as thisTypeRoomRevenueDuringTheTime from room_order_night n join room_order o on o.id = n.room_order_id join room r on r.id = o.room_id where n.night between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and r.room_type = #{roomType} and o.pay_status = 1 and o.status != 2 and o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT d.name AS name, -- 获取菜品名称 SUM(moi.quantity) AS value -- 计算每个菜品的总销量 FROM meal_order_item moi JOIN meal_order mo ON moi.meal_order_id = mo.id -- 连接餐饮订单表，获取订单信息 JOIN dish d ON moi.dish_id = d.id -- 连接菜品表，获取菜品名称 WHERE mo.created_at >= #{startDate} -- 限制订单时间范围：含结束日当天 AND mo.created_at < #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND mo.order_status != 3 -- 排除已取消 AND mo.is_deleted = 0 -- 订单未删除 AND d.is_deleted = 0 -- 菜品未删除 GROUP BY d.name -- 按照菜品名称分组 ORDER BY value DESC -- 按销量降序排序 LIMIT 10; -- 获取前 10 个销量最高的菜品

select id, room_id, checkin_time, checkout_time from room_order where checkin_time < #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY and checkout_time >= #{startDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY and pay_status = 1 and status != 2 and is_deleted = 0

select DATE(o.checkin_time) as date, count(distinct o.individual_id) as guestCount, count(distinct h.individual_id) as repeatGuestCount from room_order o left join room_order h on h.individual_id = o.individual_id and h.checkin_time < DATE(o.checkin_time) and h.pay_status = 1 and h.status != 2 and h.is_deleted = 0 where o.checkin_time >= #{startDate} and o.checkin_time < #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY and o.pay_status = 1 and o.status != 2 and o.is_deleted = 0 group by DATE(o.checkin_time)
select * from room_order where is_deleted = 0 and status = 0 and (pay_status = 1 or user_id is null) and checkout_time <= #{now}

select distinct i.* from individual i join room_order ro on i.id = ro.individual_id where ro.room_id = #{roomId} and ro.checkin_time < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY and ro.checkout_time >= #{date} and ro.is_deleted = 0
select count(*) from room_order where is_deleted = 0
select * from room_order where is_deleted = 0 and status = 0 and (pay_status = 1 or user_id is null) and #{now} >= checkin_time and #{now} < checkout_time
select * from room_order where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_status = 0), 0) AS newOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(order_status = 1), 0) AS pendingOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(order_status = 2), 0) AS doneOrderCount FROM meal_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT * FROM meal_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY created_at DESC

select moi.id as id, moi.dish_id as dishId, moi.quantity as quantity, moi.unit_price as unitPrice, moi.total_price as totalPrice, d.name as name from meal_order_item moi join dish d on moi.dish_id = d.id where meal_order_id = #{mealOrderId} and moi.is_deleted = 0
